{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency kit''' was a supply kit used on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] around the time of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The contents of the kit included a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] and two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].<ref name="Invasion">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref>

Emergency kits were also carried aboard some vehicles.<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>  a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]] used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] contained an emergency kit stored beneath one of its seats, allowing Organa to use its glow rod.<ref name="COO" />
